name: Review-only Conductor scans and previews while automatic apply and restore stay unavailable
description: A synthetic editor uses the actual authenticated local Conductor and real Server/Bridge review-only profile; scans and previews do not expose automatic write controls or establish conformance.

planSteps.description: Sign in using the configured synthetic test login if asked. Navigate directly to /projects/audit00001/accessibility.
Verify the project accessibility page explicitly says Automatic edits are unavailable and directs edits through the normal book editor.
Click Scan with Remedy, then Start Scan in the confirmation dialog. Wait until the source scan finishes and the dialog closes.
Verify the Synthetic article row contains a fixable finding and the page shows no failed-scan warning.
Open the first Fix finding button for Synthetic article. Click Preview changes and wait for the actual HTML diff.
Verify the preview contains both current and proposed page HTML, and says automatic edits are unavailable.
Verify the Apply to LibreTexts button is disabled and no I reviewed this preview and want to apply these changes checkbox is present.
Close the preview dialog. In the Remediation work queue choose Synthetic article in Page tools, then click Rescan page and wait for completion.
Verify the page-action tools have no Restore saved version button, no Apply reviewed fix and rescan button, and no Confirm restore and rescan button.
Verify the WCAG reviewer report still says verification pending and the source scan/preview has not marked content conformant.
